core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mobin is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Clear, manifest, evident”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mobin corresponds to the Arabic form مبين (Arabic root ب ي ن (b-y-n); مُبِين (Mubīn)). Its core sense is clear, manifest, evident. Mobin is Arabic مُبِين (Mubīn) 'clear, manifest, evident', from the root ب ي ن (b-y-n). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave موبين (a different form); the correct form is مُبِين. The source gloss 'Intelligent, Wise' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as mobeen.
